## Overview

These plots focus on sites that where G2G underestimated flow across events 2018-2022, but evaluating model performance from 2012-2021. <br>
Specifically, these sites had an average of < -30% peak magnitute error across both sim and sufi model configurations across events. <br>


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(gtools)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(sf)
source("../functions/load.g2g.runs.R")
source("../functions/extract.g2g.qt.R")
source("../functions/make.hydrograph.R")
source("../functions/get.stats.R")
source("../functions/plot.wales.R")

if (!dir.exists("../data/figures/poor_perform_hydrographs")){
  dir.create("../data/figures/poor_perform_hydrographs")
}
path <- "../data/figures/poor_perform_hydrographs"

g2g_output_2018_2022 <- load.g2g.data(dates = c(2012, 2021), sufi = TRUE)
obs_ts <- g2g_output_2018_2022$obs
mod_ts <- g2g_output_2018_2022$mod
## read in the events
events <- fread("../data/notable_events.csv")
events_pre_2022 <- events[Year <= 2021,]
## read in the catchment metadata
catchments <- fread("../data/cdata/catchment_cdata_EA-NRW.csv", fill = Inf)
## filter by wales
wales <- st_read("../data/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC_-1059615406868623242/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC.shp")
wales <- st_transform(wales, 27700)

catchments_sf <- st_as_sf(
  catchments,
  coords = c("WISKI.EASTING", "WISKI.NORTHING"),
  crs = 27700,
  remove = FALSE
)
wales_poly <- st_union(wales)
sf_g2g_ids <- unique(c(catchments_sf[st_intersects(catchments_sf, wales_poly, sparse = FALSE), ]$G2G.ID, catchments[Region. == "Wales"]$G2G.ID)) ## use both ids coded as Wales, plus anything inside the polygon
wales_cdata <- catchments[G2G.ID %in% sf_g2g_ids]## filter by wales


qt_grid_paths <- mixedsort(sort(file.path("../data/qt_grids", list.files("../data/qt_grids")))) ## create relative paths
qt_val <- sub("_.*", "", mixedsort(sort(list.files("../data/qt_grids"))))
qt_grid_list <- lapply(qt_grid_paths, read.ascii)
names(qt_grid_list) <- qt_val ## name by qt

qt_dt <- make.qt.csv(qt_grid_list, cdata = wales_cdata)


pme_output <- fread("../data/pme_sim_sufi_events_2018_2021.csv")
poor_sites <- pme_output[sim_mean_pme < -30 | sufi_mean_pme < -30]$G2G.ID

years <- c("2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016", "2017", "2018", "2019", "2020", "2021")
pstart <- list()
for (i in 1:9){
  pstart[[i]] <- years[i]
}
pend <- list()
for (i in 1:9){
  pend[[i]] <- years[i+1]
}

sufi_data <- fread("../data/sites_list_final.csv")
sufi_data <- sufi_data[,.(G2G.ID, SU, FI)] ## extract cols of use
stats <- list()

for (g2g_id in poor_sites){
  cat("Starting plot for g2g site:", g2g_id, "\n")
    sim <- mod_ts$sim[, .SD, .SDcols = c("DATE_TIME", paste0(g2g_id, "_Mod"))]
    sufi <- mod_ts$sufi[, .SD, .SDcols = c("DATE_TIME", paste0(g2g_id, "_Mod"))]
    obs <- obs_ts[, .SD, .SDcols = c("DATE_TIME", paste0(g2g_id, "_Obs"))]
    event <- list(sim = sim, sufi = sufi, obs =obs)
    stats[[g2g_id]] <- list()
    stats[[g2g_id]]$sim <- get.stats(mod = event$sim, obs = event$obs)
    stats[[g2g_id]]$sufi <- get.stats(mod = event$sufi, obs = event$obs)
    site_stats <- stats[[g2g_id]]


    stats_text <- sprintf(
    "Performance (Sim | SUFI)\nKGE: %.2f | %.2f\nBias: %.1f%% | %.1f%%\nR^2: %.2f | %.2f",
    site_stats$sim$KGE, site_stats$sufi$KGE,
    site_stats$sim$perc_bias, site_stats$sufi$perc_bias,
    site_stats$sim$R2, site_stats$sufi$R2
    )
    plots <- list()
    for (i in seq_along(pend)) {
      cat("plotting year panel", pstart[[i]], "\n")
      plots[[i]] <- make.hydrograph.sim.sufi(
        event,
        g2g.id = g2g_id,
        storm.name = "",
        cdata = wales_cdata,
        qt.data = qt_dt,
        sufi = sufi_data,
        pstart = as.POSIXct(paste(pstart[[i]], "1", "1", sep = "-"), tz = "GMT"),
        pend = as.POSIXct(paste(pend[[i]], "1", "1", sep = "-"), tz = "GMT"),
        theme(,
        legend.title    = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        # aspect.ratio = 0.8,
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_blank())
      )
    }

    combined <- wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1, guides = "collect") +
      plot_annotation(
        title = g2g_id,
        subtitle = stats_text
      ) &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    cat("Saving g2g id:", g2g_id, "\n")
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(path, paste0(g2g_id, "__2012_2021_hydrograph.png")), ## save hydrograph
      plot = combined,
      width = 12,
      height = 18, ## tall because 10 years/columns
      units = "in",
      dpi = 300
    )
    print(combined)
}

stats_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(names(stats), function(g2g_id) {
  rbindlist(list(
    cbind(data.table(G2G.ID = g2g_id, model = "sim"), as.data.table(stats[[g2g_id]]$sim)),
    cbind(data.table(G2G.ID = g2g_id, model = "sufi"), as.data.table(stats[[g2g_id]]$sufi))
  ), fill = TRUE)
}), fill = TRUE)
fwrite(stats_dt,"../data/poor_performing_g2g_sites_stats_2012_2021.csv")


## plot where these bad performing sites are
wales <- st_read("../data/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC_-1059615406868623242/SENC_MAY_2026_WA_BFC.shp")
wales <- st_transform(wales, 27700) # Ensure CRS is BNG (should already be, but safe to enforce)

r2_dt <- stats_dt[model == "sufi", .(G2G.ID, R2)] ## extract r^2, can replace with any other stat
kge_dt <- stats_dt[model == "sufi", .(G2G.ID, KGE)] ## extract r^2, can replace with any other stat
perc_bias_dt <- stats_dt[model == "sufi", .(G2G.ID, perc_bias)] ## extract r^2, can replace with any other stat

p <- plot.single.point(poor_sites, cdata = wales_cdata, wales, fill.variable =r2_dt , theme(plot.title = element_blank()))
print(p)

p <- plot.single.point(poor_sites, cdata = wales_cdata, wales, fill.variable =kge_dt, theme(plot.title = element_blank()) )
print(p)

p <- plot.single.point(poor_sites, cdata = wales_cdata, wales, fill.variable =perc_bias_dt, theme(plot.title = element_blank()) )
print(p)



```
